exposure: Topical application of amniotic fluid-derived multipotent stromal cells (AFMSCs)
outcome: Molecular and cellular events (e.g., macrophage composition, macrophage polarizing cytokines)
cohort: Leprdb/db diabetic mice with 10 mm splinted cutaneous wounds.
finding: Treatment of diabetic wounds with amniotic fluid-derived multipotent stromal cells (AFMSCs) significantly accelerated wound closure and modulated macrophage composition in the wound bed, suggesting therapeutic effect through paracrine activities.
